author: Bellular News
description:
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund spent $55 billion on EA. Now money is getting tighter, Savvy Games Group's CEO has left, and a reported merger could bring both gaming businesses together. We've already seen what happens when funding disappears at Embracer and NetEase. How much of the games industry now depends on the Saudi Crown Prince staying interested?

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
